0.original: As is her wont, Qeshi-Rae wants to discuss the samiel with you.

28.original: Speak with Qeshi-Rae at the Crystalline Mean.

48.original: In order to undertake this quest, you must first complete the main scenario quest “Acht-la Ormh Inn.”

49.original: Yes, this is truly a mystery... We <hex:021A020203>know<hex:021A020103> that the samiel is out there─it's left plenty of evidence of its passage. So why can't we find it?

51.original: Yalana, you should know better than to run at full tilt! You're an academic─you're liable to kill yourself!

52.original: N-Never mind me! It's Mao─he's gone off to Il Mheg to search for the samiel...alone!

54.original: The other researchers, they blamed him for putting the idea of the samiel into your head. “It's because of you she's chasing some fool myth,” they jeered.

55.original: Mao couldn't bear their barbs, and in his anger, he rushed off with little more than the clothes on his back!

56.original: There's no time to waste! We must find him before he runs afoul of the faeries!

57.original: B-But, Chief! What if <hex:021A020203>we<hex:021A020103> run afoul of the faeries?

58.original: We'll have <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> with us. <hex:02080CE905FF04536865FF03486503> has friends among the pixies. Isn't that right?

59.original: I see... Yes, we'd be much assured if you could ask the pixies of Lydha Lran after Mao's whereabouts.

60.original: While you see to that, Yalana and I will cast around by the entrance. Come and find us after you've made your inquiries. Now then, let us hurry!

61.original: The man with the big ears? Ooh, yes, I know the one! Was chasing him, as a matter of fact!

62.original: Unfortunately, I lost sight of him west of the lake. If I see him again, I'll turn him into a cute leafman! Tee hee!

63.original: What!? A mortal's come here to play!? Nobody told me that! That's not fair! I'm so bored! Bored, bored, bored! I want to play with him too!

64.original: Hmmm? That mortal's your friend, you say? Had I known that, I would've greeted him with a shove into the lake! Tee hee hee!

65.original: It appears Mao-Ladd is somewhere near Longmirror Lake. Time to take word to the others, who await you at Timh Gyeus.

66.original: I've only dared set foot in Il Mheg a few times. The place is at once beautiful and terrifying.

68.original: I lost sight of the man with the big ears west of the lake.

69.original: If I see him again, I'll turn him into a cute leafman! Tee hee!

70.original: Nobody told me about the mortal! That's not fair! I'm so bored! Bored, bored, bored! I want to play with him too!

71.original: Had I known that mortal was your friend, I would've greeted him with a shove into the lake! Tee hee hee!

72.original: There you are. Were you able to learn anything about Mao's whereabouts?

73.original: Truly? Thank you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! We could never have located him without your help!

74.original: Come, let's make haste to Longmirror Lake. Quickly and quietly does it...

75.original: What were you thinking, lad? You could've been killed, or worse!

76.original: He's safe, thank goodness. It's a miracle he managed to come this far unharmed.

77.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I'm so sorry for all the trouble!

78.original: And so you should be! The chief alone is enough of a handful─I can't chase you down as well!

79.original: B-But the others, they spoke ill of the chief. I couldn't just stand by and take it.

80.original: I know it was reckless of me to come out here alone...but thanks to that, I was able to find an actual part of the samiel!

81.original: There's...er, just one problem─in my haste, I forgot my tools. <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, you seem to have yours. Could you do the collecting in my stead?

82.original: Lest you wonder, it's a shred of scaly skin. I spotted it in this area, Timh Gyeus, after noticing rub marks on the trees and rocks.

83.original: I spotted the skin in this area, Timh Gyeus, after noticing rub marks on the trees and rocks. Please collect it in my stead.

84.original: While droppings can tell us much about a creature, there's no substitute for an actual piece of it. In spite of myself, I'm quite excited, I must admit!

85.original: So, did you find the shred of skin?

86.original: Mmm-hmmm! While it's a little on the shriveled side, this is indeed skin from the creature. It was likely molting.

87.original: A molting creature! That's one more thing we know about it! I can't wait to see what else this specimen can tell us!

91.original: Th-That's odd... It was there just a moment ago. And its shape─I'd swear it matches that of the shadow I saw in Amh Araeng.

92.original: I don't know how, but it literally disappeared in the blink of an eye.

93.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, you saw it too, didn't you? It wasn't just my imagination?

94.original: Truly!? It was right there, and I missed it!? Gah, of all the rotten luck!

95.original: Tell me, what did it look like? What was its color? Smell? Size?

96.original: Chief, perhaps we should save the questions for after we leave this place. Even with <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, it may not be entirely safe for us here.

97.original: Yes, you have the right of it. It wouldn't do to have the faeries get their hands on our precious specimen. Come, let's return to the Crystarium.

98.original: Thank you for helping us to find Mao-Ladd. I shudder to think what may have happened to him.

99.original: Anger carried my steps to Il Mheg, but it quickly gave way to terror. I'm in your debt.

100.original: Well, that was certainly a harrowing outing, but it wasn't without fruit─in the form of a piece of the samiel itself! Ahhh, to feel the scaly texture in my hands and breathe in its mysterious smell... Pure bliss, I tell you!

101.original: Alas, Yalana snatched it from me before I could have a little taste...

102.original: Well, for now we'll just have to leave her to her task. I'm sure she'll have new information for us before long, so do not wander far!

103.original: The next request will be available from Qeshi-Rae upon reaching level 78 as a miner or botanist.
